description: Asking what network I'm on maps to network/current_network.
prompt: What network am I connected to?

description: Asking which DNS resolvers are in use maps to dns_servers.
prompt: What DNS servers is my Mac using?

description: A reachability question maps to ping_host. Uses 1.1.1.1 so the case needs only outbound ICMP, not a LAN scan.
Resolving a hostname to an IP maps to dns_lookup.
prompt: What's the IP address for example.com?

description: Asking what is listening on the machine maps to listening_ports (loopback-only, no external dependency).
prompt: What ports are listening on my machine?

description: A LAN device sweep maps to scan_lan, but an active subnet sweep is not appropriate for an unattended CI pass (network side effects, variable results), so this case is manual-only. Selection assertion is still recorded for a human run.
prompt: Scan my local network for devices.
